topic.name: Архитектура V8: от кода до машинных инструкций

question.questionText: Как устроена архитектура V8 и как JavaScript-код превращается в машинные инструкции?
question.shortAnswer: V8 компилирует JS через pipeline: Parser → AST, Ignition → bytecode + type feedback, Sparkplug → baseline machine code, TurboFan → optimized machine code. При нарушении type assumptions — deoptimization обратно в bytecode. Стабильные типы на call site держат TurboFan активным.
question.idealAnswer: V8 pipeline: Parser строит AST из source без runtime types. Ignition компилирует AST в compact bytecode и сразу исполняет, записывая type feedback на каждой инструкции (Add saw two Smi). Sparkplug (V8 9.1+) — 1:1 bytecode→machine, ~2x Ignition, без speculation. TurboFan после ~1000-2000 calls с consistent feedback: type specialization, inlining, loop unrolling, ~10x vs interpret; ставка на стабильность типов — mismatch → deopt через OSR back to bytecode, deopt map persists. Hidden Classes (Maps): объекты с same property order share class, IC caches offset. IC states: monomorphic (1 class, best), polymorphic (2-4), megamorphic (5+, generic lookup every call). GC: Young Scavenge 1-2ms, promote after 2 cycles; Old Mark-Sweep-Compact 50-100ms pause. Ошибки: mixed types in hot serialize(); try/catch around hot loop kills inlining; delete obj.prop new Hidden Class; dynamic property add after {}. Profile: node --trace-deopt, --trace-opt. React reconciliation hot in TurboFan; useMemo stabilizes shapes. TensorFlow.js typed arrays bypass object overhead.

checkpoints.title: Описывает pipeline Parser → Ignition → Sparkplug → TurboFan
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: Parser AST; Ignition bytecode+feedback; Sparkplug baseline; TurboFan optimized from feedback; deopt on type break.

probeConceptGroups.ask: опиши путь функции от JS source до native code без кода

falseClaims: V8 только интерпретирует JS без компиляции
TurboFan запускается на первом вызове функции
Sparkplug делает speculative optimization как TurboFan
Parser выполняет код напрямую без AST
bytecode и machine code — одно и то же

checkpoints.title: Понимает Hidden Classes и Inline Caching
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: Maps/Shapes; same property order share class; IC caches property offset; getX(point.x) monomorphic fast.

falseClaims: property metadata stored directly on each object always
different property order same Hidden Class
IC works without Hidden Classes
adding property never changes Hidden Class

checkpoints.title: Различает monomorphic, polymorphic, megamorphic
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: mono 1 class full inline best; poly 2-4 dispatch table; mega 5+ generic lookup; 10x diff in hot loops.

probeConceptGroups.ask: что происходит когда call site получает 5+ разных форм объектов

falseClaims: megamorphic fastest because generic
polymorphic and monomorphic same speed
IC state does not affect TurboFan
more object shapes always better for IC

checkpoints.title: Объясняет deoptimization и type mismatch
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: TurboFan assumptions break → OSR deopt to bytecode; add(1,2) then add('x','y'); --trace-deopt; deopt map lingers.

falseClaims: deoptimization never happens after TurboFan
one string call does not affect future int optimization ever
deopt is free with no performance cost
TurboFan never speculates on types

checkpoints.title: Знает generational garbage collection V8
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: Young Scavenge 1-2ms short-lived; promote Old; Mark-Sweep-Compact 50-100ms; temp objects die in Young.

falseClaims: all objects go directly to Old Generation
Scavenge pause same as full GC always
GC never causes latency in Node
long-lived temp objects have no GC cost

checkpoints.title: Знает антипаттерны для V8 optimization
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: mixed arg types hot fn; try/catch hot loop; delete property; dynamic add after {}; separate call sites per type.

falseClaims: try/catch around loop does not affect inlining
delete obj.prop keeps same Hidden Class
mixed types in hot function harmless
dynamic property add same as literal object init

checkpoints.title: Понимает OSR и deopt в async/generators
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: OSR swaps optimized frame on stack without full unwind; critical for suspended generator/async partial frames.

probeConceptGroups.ask: зачем OSR важен для deopt suspended async function

falseClaims: deopt always requires full stack unwind
async functions never optimized by TurboFan
OSR unrelated to deoptimization
generators never hit TurboFan
